# Traccar Client (Flutter, traccar-client-sdk v10.x) — HttpUploader.kt submitForm:
# POST /api/osmand
# Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
# Body: id, lat, lon, timestamp (unix s), speed (knots), bearing, altitude, accuracy, batt, charge, alarm
# Source: https://github.com/traccar/traccar-client-sdk/blob/master/core/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/traccar/client/HttpUploader.kt

POST /api/osmand
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

id=DEVICE_TOKEN&lat=48.8566&lon=2.3522&timestamp=1609459200&speed=15&bearing=270&altitude=35&accuracy=10&batt=75

# Legacy native Android (traccar-client-android) — query string on POST, empty body:
# GET|POST /api/osmand?id=...&timestamp=...&lat=...&lon=...&speed=...&bearing=...&altitude=...&accuracy=...
